question: For each statement about access to Microsoft Service Trust Portal resources, select Yes if it is accurate; otherwise select No.

items.text: Some compliance materials require an authenticated Microsoft cloud services account.
Some materials require acceptance of the applicable nondisclosure agreement.
Every restricted document is available to every anonymous visitor.

explanation: Some Service Trust Portal materials require authentication and acceptance of a nondisclosure agreement; restricted documents can also require specified roles.
learningObjective: Describe the Service Trust Portal offerings

question: According to Microsoft's commercial cloud privacy documentation, when can Microsoft share customer data with a third party?

options.text: Whenever the third party requests direct, unrestricted access
Only when authorized by the customer or required by applicable law
Automatically for advertising without customer authorization
Whenever a user creates a retention label

explanation: Microsoft's privacy documentation states that it shares data with third parties only when authorized by the customer or required by applicable law.

optionExplanations.A: A request does not itself authorize unrestricted access.
optionExplanations.B: The published commitment identifies customer authorization or applicable legal requirements.
optionExplanations.C: The published commitment does not authorize automatic advertising use.
optionExplanations.D: Creating a retention label is not an authorization for third-party sharing.

learningObjective: Describe the privacy principles of Microsoft

question: In Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager, what is an assessment?

options.text: A group of controls from a specific regulation, standard, or policy
A guarantee that the organization is legally compliant
A network rule blocking inbound traffic
A list of virtual machine passwords

explanation: An assessment groups controls from a particular regulation, standard, or policy to help track compliance activities.

optionExplanations.A: An assessment is a grouping of controls against a relevant requirement set.
optionExplanations.B: An assessment supports compliance work but is not a legal guarantee.
optionExplanations.C: A network rule is not a Compliance Manager assessment.
optionExplanations.D: An assessment is not a password list.

question: Match each Compliance Manager improvement-action category to the example.

items.text: Encrypt information at rest to reduce exposure
Audit system access to identify irregular activity
Respond to a privacy incident to limit and reverse damage

explanation: Preventative actions address risk before an incident, detective actions identify irregularities, and corrective actions reduce or reverse incident effects.
learningObjective: Describe the uses and benefits of compliance score

question: A data protection team needs a custom sensitive information type that matches values from its own structured dataset rather than relying only on a generic pattern. Which classification method is intended for this?

options.text: A Sentinel workbook
An Azure Firewall rule
Exact data match
A privileged role activation

explanation: Exact data match supports custom sensitive information types that compare content against values in a structured sensitive data source.

optionExplanations.A: A workbook visualizes data rather than defining a sensitive information type.
optionExplanations.B: A firewall rule filters network traffic.
optionExplanations.C: Exact data match uses an organization's structured values for classification.
optionExplanations.D: Role activation changes privileged access rather than classifying data.

question: A compliance analyst is evaluating Activity explorer for investigating data-related events. For each statement, select Yes if it is accurate; otherwise select No.

items.text: With Endpoint DLP enabled, activity can include copying a file to the clipboard on an onboarded device.
Activities are guaranteed to appear in real time as soon as they occur.
Date range and activity type can be used to filter the activity data.

explanation: Activity explorer can include endpoint DLP activities such as copying a file to the clipboard. It isn't a real-time view: events arrive on the audit-log schedule. Date range and activity type are available filters.
learningObjective: Describe the benefits of Content explorer and Activity explorer

question: An organization must retain contract records for five years after each contract expires, rather than five years after the files were created. What should the records team evaluate?

options.text: An access review
A network security group
A Defender for Endpoint isolation action
Event-based retention using a retention label

explanation: An event-based retention label can start the retention period when a specified event, such as a contract expiration, occurs.

optionExplanations.A: An access review assesses access rather than triggering content retention.
optionExplanations.C: Device isolation is a security response action.
optionExplanations.D: Event-based retention starts the configured period from the relevant event.

question: A records team is considering applying a retention label that marks content as a regulatory record. Which statement about the restrictions is accurate?

options.text: A container administrator can remove the label from the marked item
No administrator can remove the regulatory record label after it is applied
An administrator can shorten the label's retention period after the label is saved
An auto-apply retention label policy can apply the regulatory record label

explanation: A regulatory record label cannot be removed after application, including by a global administrator; the restrictions make careful planning important.

optionExplanations.A: A container administrator can remove a label from a locked record, but not from a regulatory record.
optionExplanations.B: The applied regulatory record label cannot be removed, even by a global administrator.
optionExplanations.C: After the label is saved, its retention period can be extended but not shortened.
optionExplanations.D: Regulatory record labels aren't supported by auto-labeling policies; they must be applied using retention label policies.

question: A legal team needs to preserve mailbox and site content relevant to an investigation against inadvertent deletion. What eDiscovery capability addresses this need?

options.text: A case hold on the relevant content locations
An Azure DDoS protection plan
A user password reset
A Sentinel workbook

explanation: An eDiscovery case hold preserves content in selected locations for an investigation.

optionExplanations.A: A case hold preserves relevant content locations during an investigation.
optionExplanations.C: Password reset recovers account access rather than preserving content.
optionExplanations.D: A workbook visualizes security data rather than placing content on hold.

learningObjective: Describe eDiscovery solutions in Microsoft Purview

question: A legal reviewer needs to tag collected case documents as relevant or nonresponsive before further analysis. Which premium eDiscovery feature supports this work?

options.text: A Conditional Access policy
An Azure virtual network
Review set tagging
A password ban list

explanation: Review set tagging allows reviewers to classify case content and use those tags to filter subsequent review.

optionExplanations.C: Review set tags capture reviewer judgments about collected items.
optionExplanations.D: A password ban list helps reject weak passwords.

learningObjective: Describe eDiscovery solutions in Microsoft Purview

question: An organization with Audit (Premium) wants to retain eligible user audit records for 10 years. In addition to the applicable Premium license and an appropriate policy, what is required?

options.text: An Azure Bastion Premium host
A new network security group
A sensitivity label on every mailbox
The 10-Year Audit Log Retention add-on license for the user

explanation: Ten-year retention for eligible user audit records requires the applicable Audit (Premium) licensing, the per-user add-on, and an appropriate retention policy.

optionExplanations.A: Bastion provides VM access and is unrelated to audit retention licensing.
optionExplanations.B: An NSG does not provide audit retention licensing.
optionExplanations.C: Sensitivity labels do not substitute for the audit retention add-on.
optionExplanations.D: The additional per-user add-on and appropriate policy are required.

learningObjective: Describe audit solutions in Microsoft Purview

question: An insider risk investigation requires additional legal review of relevant content. Which integration can help the risk team escalate the case for that review?

options.text: Create an Azure Firewall policy
Escalate the Insider Risk Management case to Microsoft Purview eDiscovery
Add the user to a network security group
Turn off all audit logging

explanation: Insider Risk Management cases can be escalated to eDiscovery for additional legal review.

optionExplanations.A: A firewall policy filters network traffic rather than managing legal case review.
optionExplanations.B: The integration supports escalation to an eDiscovery case.
optionExplanations.C: NSGs are network controls, not user memberships or legal cases.
optionExplanations.D: Disabling audit logging does not support case escalation.

learningObjective: Describe insider risk management; describe eDiscovery solutions in Microsoft Purview
